purpose: The reasoning a gold-plating bench uses to decide what every stream leaving the shop actually is, how it is segregated at the tank, contained, characterized, documented and handed to a licensed destination, which streams carry recoverable gold and how that value is honestly accounted, and how drag-out, rinse and emission-control choices reshape the waste picture — never how to make a plating waste stream disappear on site.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
the shop is a small commercial gold-plating jewelry bench running purchased commercial chemistry per its supplier technical data sheet, not a licensed waste-treatment facility

both common gold routes are in scope: alkaline cyanide gold (strike plus build bath) and cyanide-free sulfite gold, each sitting on a nickel underplate line with an acid pickle and an alkaline electrocleaner upstream

the shop is a waste GENERATOR, not a handler: every regulated stream leaves via a licensed handler under paperwork, and nothing is treated, diluted, evaporated or discharged on site to make it go away

every numeric threshold, waste code, accumulation hold time, generator category and record-retention period is a jurisdiction variable to confirm with the naming authority; this KB supplies the classes and the mechanisms only
exclusions: hazard classes, PPE, ventilation as worker protection, storage and labeling of in-use purchased chemicals, spill and exposure response readiness (kits, drills, signage) and training/competency records — that is the sibling Chemical Safety Operations KB; this KB begins at the moment a material becomes waste

regulated marking and advertising terms ('gold plated', 'vermeil', 'gold filled', 'rolled gold'), nickel-release limits for skin-contact goods, durability claims and claim record trails — that is the sibling Marking, Claims & Consumer Rules KB

bath diagnosis, analysis, replenishment and the judgement of whether a sick bath can still be corrected — that belongs to the bath-chemistry specialist; a bath enters this KB only once it has been declared retired

rinse-quality specification for finish adhesion and staining, rack design for current distribution, and part-handling sequence — process-execution territory; only their waste and drag-out consequences are reasoned about here
any numeric discharge limit, waste code, accumulation hold time, generator-category threshold or retention period asserted as universal fact — every one is a verify-in-your-jurisdiction class
sewer, storm-drain, soakaway, evaporation-to-air, solidify-and-bin or any other self-disposal route for plating solutions, rinse waters or sludges

on-site cyanide destruction or any other chemical treatment written as a bench procedure — treatment is named only as a licensed, engineered and monitored operation with a verification step, never as instructions to follow
medical advice on chemical exposure, inhalation or metal sensitisation — those route to professional medical care and to the regulation classes, never to self-treatment
DIY bath formulation or reclaim refining from raw chemicals; content assumes purchased commercial chemistry used per its technical data sheet and refining done by a licensed reclaimer

competency_questions.question: What actually leaves this bench, and which of those streams are regulated waste rather than trash or wastewater?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: WASTE_STREAM_INVENTORY enumerates every liquid, solid and airborne output with its parent chemistry and gold-bearing flag, and WASTE_CHARACTERIZATION assigns each one a regulated class with the evidence behind it

competency_questions.question: How do I keep cyanide-bearing and acid-bearing material apart all the way from the tank to the collection vehicle, including drains, spill residues and shared equipment?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: STREAM_SEGREGATION_MAP states the never-mixed, never-stored-together, never-shared-drain line as physical architecture, CYANIDE_WASTE_CLASS states the never-acidify rule for the stream itself, and SPILL_RESIDUE_HANDLING keeps the segregation intact after a spill

competency_questions.question: How do I characterize a stream when all I really know is the commercial product name on the drum?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: WASTE_CHARACTERIZATION derives the class from the safety data sheets and technical data sheets of everything that went in plus the process log, names when supplier or accredited-laboratory analysis is required instead, and JURISDICTION_RULE_MAP supplies which authority defines the coding

competency_questions.question: What container does each stream go into, and how must it be labeled, dated, stored and inspected while it waits for collection?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ACCUMULATION_CONTAINERS gives the compatibility, closure, labeling, dating, secondary-containment and inspection obligations and names hold time and container marking as jurisdiction classes to confirm

competency_questions.question: Where is my gold actually going — how much of it leaves on the parts versus in drag-out, rinse water, filters and sludge?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DRAGOUT_REDUCTION explains the carry-out mechanism and its levers and METAL_ACCOUNTING_HONESTY gives the mass-balance frame (purchased in, deposited by area-thickness-density arithmetic, reclaimed back, unaccounted) with estimates labeled as estimates

competency_questions.question: How do I cut drag-out losses and rinse-water volume without under-rinsing the work?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DRAGOUT_REDUCTION and DRAGOUT_RECOVERY_RINSE give the withdrawal, drain-time, rack and still-rinse mechanisms, RINSE_WATER_ARCHITECTURE gives counterflow and segregated rinse lines, and the rinse-quality criterion is stated as the floor water reduction may not cross

competency_questions.question: Which of my streams are worth sending to a precious-metal reclaimer, and how do I prepare and hand over a lot?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: GOLD_BEARING_ROUTING flags every gold-bearing stream including solids, FILTER_MEDIA_AND_SLUDGE covers the solid fraction, and RECLAIMER_CONTRACT states the sampling, weighing, chain-of-custody and settlement terms to agree before shipping

competency_questions.question: What may I honestly book as recovered gold value, and when?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: METAL_ACCOUNTING_HONESTY separates estimated content from settled assay, books only settlement figures, and RECLAIMER_CONTRACT explains why the shop's estimate and the refiner's assay legitimately differ

competency_questions.question: A bath has been declared dead — what now happens to the liquid, the tank sludge and the filters, and what changes if it is a cyanide bath?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SPENT_BATH_RETIREMENT gives the gold-first-then-regulated-stream sequence, FILTER_MEDIA_AND_SLUDGE covers the solids a dump generates, and CYANIDE_WASTE_CLASS adds the never-acidify and licensed-destination obligations for the cyanide route

competency_questions.question: How do I find and appoint a licensed hauler and destination, and what paperwork has to travel with the load?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LICENSED_HANDLER_MANIFEST covers generator registration, permit verification for transporter and destination, the consignment or manifest document travelling with the load, and the signed return copy, with the document names and thresholds flagged as jurisdiction classes

competency_questions.question: May any plating-line water go down the drain, and what about what the extraction fan throws out of the roof?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DISCHARGE_PERMIT_CLASS states that discharge authority comes only from an explicit written permit and that the default is zero discharge, and AIR_EMISSION_CONTROL_CLASS treats the extraction outlet as a permit-class emission point whose control media become their own waste

competency_questions.question: What records must exist, how long do I keep them, and what would I show an inspector or an insurer?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: WASTE_RECORDS_TRAIL lists the record set (characterizations, consignment copies, handler permits, settlement statements, inspection and pickup logs) and shows it reconstructing where every litre and gram went, and JOB_RELEASE_WASTE_GATE shows the records being used as a live release check

competency_questions.question: Can the nickel and pickle line share anything at all with the gold line — drums, rinse tanks, floor drains, pickup?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: NICKEL_ACID_PRETREAT_WASTE gives the separate handling class for nickel and acid streams and STREAM_SEGREGATION_MAP gives the physical rule for what may and may not share collection, storage and drain paths

glossary.definition: The film of process solution carried out of a tank on the parts, the rack and the barrel when they are withdrawn. It is simultaneously the shop's largest routine gold loss, the thing that contaminates the next tank, and the origin of most rinse-water waste volume; the in-repo cost notes for the cyanide gold route record that at small scale drag-out losses often exceed the gold actually deposited unless a still drag-out rinse returns solution to the bath.

An unflowing rinse tank placed immediately after a process tank, holding the same chemistry in dilute form. Parts are dipped in it first so most of the drag-out is captured in a small concentrated volume that can be returned to the parent bath as evaporation make-up instead of becoming waste, and only the residue goes forward to the flowing rinses.

Two or more rinse tanks in series where fresh water enters the last tank and overflows backwards towards the first, so the dirtiest water leaves from the tank nearest the process bath. It reaches a given rinse cleanliness on a fraction of the water a single running rinse needs, which cuts both water cost and the volume of contaminated rinse water that must leave as waste.

The generator's duty to determine what a waste actually is before it moves — its hazard properties and its regulatory class — using knowledge of every input (safety data sheets, technical data sheets, the process log) and, where knowledge is not sufficient or the authority requires it, laboratory analysis. Guessing is not characterization, and an uncharacterized container cannot lawfully be handed to anyone.

The legal role of the business whose activity produced the waste. The generator owns the characterization, the container condition, the paperwork accuracy and, in most regimes, a continuing duty of care for what happens to the material downstream; generator category and its consequences are jurisdiction classes to confirm with the naming authority.

The controlled document that travels with a regulated waste load, identifying the generator, the description and class of the waste, the quantity, the licensed transporter and the licensed destination facility, and returning to the generator signed by the receiver as proof the load arrived. Its exact name, format and copy-retention rules differ by jurisdiction and must be confirmed locally.

A licensed refiner that buys or processes gold-bearing material — spent baths, still-rinse concentrate, filters, sludges, sweeps and scrap — recovering the metal and settling with the shop on assayed content. It converts what would be a disposal cost into a metal credit, which is why gold-bearing streams are routed to reclaim first and only their residue enters the disposal route.

The reclaimer's determination of how much recoverable gold a delivered lot actually contained, made after the lot is dried, homogenized, sampled and analysed, and expressed net of the refining charge and the agreed returns percentage. It, not the shop's estimate, is the number that may be booked.

The classic engineered treatment route in which cyanide in a spent bath or rinse is oxidised under strongly alkaline conditions with a hypochlorite reagent, with the residual cyanide verified against a discharge limit afterwards. It is named here as what a licensed treatment facility does, and as the reason a licensed destination exists — it is not a bench procedure for a jewelry shop and never a reason to acidify anything.

The solid or semi-solid fraction that settles in a tank bottom, is retained on a filter cartridge or filter aid, or is left after a spill cleanup. It concentrates metals — often including gold — is wet with the parent chemistry so it carries that chemistry's hazard class, and is regulated as a waste in its own right rather than being shop rubbish.

nodes.definition: Before a single drum is bought or a collection booked, establish who actually regulates this shop's outputs and write it down: the environmental or waste authority that defines waste classification, generator duties and the consignment paperwork; the water utility or trade-effluent authority that owns whatever the floor and sink drains connect to; the air or local permitting authority that owns the extraction outlet; and the poisons, precursor or hazmat licensing regime that governs holding cyanide chemistry at all, which the in-repo cyanide-gold process notes explicitly mark as jurisdiction-specific and unresolved. The work unit is a dated register: one row per output class, naming the authority, the obligation the shop believes applies, the evidence for that belief, and an explicit unconfirmed flag wherever the answer has not yet come from the authority itself. This is pointer discipline rather than legal interpretation — the classes of rule are the same everywhere plating happens, while the codes, thresholds and hold times are local and only the authority or a qualified adviser supplies them.

included: identifying the regulator for each output class (liquid waste, solid waste, drain, stack, precious-metal shipment)
a dated rule register with confirmed/unconfirmed status per row
supplier safety and technical data sheets as the primary technical input to any rule question
the trigger list that forces a re-check
excluded: asserting numeric limits, waste codes or hold times as universal fact
legal sign-off, which is a human and jurisdictional act
worker exposure, PPE and training rules, which belong to the chemical-safety sibling KB

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an authority answers in writing, or a rule, permit condition or licence status changes

pros.claim: A dated register turns 'verify your jurisdiction' from a disclaimer into a finite, assignable checklist
pros.example: the register shows the trade-effluent authority was never contacted, so every rinse tank stays on the ship-out route until it is

pros.claim: Knowing the authority before buying equipment prevents committing to a waste route the regulator does not accept
pros.example: confirming that a hauler must hold a specific permit class for cyanide-bearing liquids before signing a collection contract

cons.claim: The register goes stale silently: permits, licences and rules change without anyone telling a five-person shop
cons.example: a hauler's permit lapses between two annual collections and nobody re-checks before the next load is handed over

cons.claim: Getting written answers from several authorities is slow and can stall a shop that is already producing waste
cons.example: waiting weeks for a trade-effluent answer while rinse water accumulates in drums that were only meant to be interim

failure_modes: treating a generic handbook, a forum post or a supplier's home-market advice as if it were the local rule
assuming no rule applies because the shop is small, part-time or hobby-scale
recording an assumption in the register without marking it unconfirmed, so a guess hardens into a documented fact
acceptance_tests: every output class (spent bath, rinse water, solid residue, floor and sink drains, extraction outlet, precious-metal shipment) names a specific authority and carries either a dated confirmation or an explicit unconfirmed flag
no row of the register states a numeric limit, code or hold time that is not attributed to a named authority document
revisit_triggers: the register's annual review date is reached
a new chemistry, process or substrate is introduced
a hauler, reclaimer or shop permit or licence comes up for renewal
any regulator notice, inspection or enforcement contact

nodes.definition: List everything that physically leaves the bench, not just the obvious drums. On a gold line that means: spent gold strike and spent build bath; the still drag-out rinse and every flowing rinse after gold, nickel, pickle and electrocleaner; spent nickel bath and spent Wood's nickel or copper strike; spent hydrochloric pickle and spent alkaline electrocleaner; filter cartridges, filter aid and the sludge on tank bottoms; anode bags and anode debris; rack stripping solution and rework stripping solution from re-plated customer goods; contaminated gloves, wipes, absorbent and floor-wash water; empty chemical containers; and the exhausted media from any extraction scrubber or filter. Each row records the parent chemistry, physical form, whether it is gold-bearing, whether it is cyanide-bearing or acidic, and roughly how fast it arrives — per bath change, per rack, per week. Everything downstream indexes into this list, so a stream that is missing here is a stream that will eventually be poured somewhere convenient.

included: liquid, solid and airborne outputs of the whole wet line including pretreatment
parent-chemistry and gold-bearing flags per stream
arrival rate and physical form
occasional and rework streams such as stripping solution and spill cleanup residue
excluded: why a bath died or whether it could have been saved, which is bath-chemistry work
in-use chemical stock and its storage, which is the chemical-safety sibling KB
the finished parts themselves and their marking claims

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a stream is discovered that is not on the list, or the line changes

pros.claim: An explicit stream list makes the forgettable streams visible before they become an incident
pros.example: listing anode bags and tank sludge alongside the spent bath, so the gold-bearing solids do not end up in the workshop bin

pros.claim: Arrival rates convert the list into a capacity and pickup-cadence plan instead of a static document
pros.example: knowing the still rinse fills roughly every two weeks tells you the collection interval before drums start standing in the corridor

cons.claim: The list is only as good as the shop's honesty about informal practice, and informal practice is exactly what does not get written down
cons.example: nobody records the bucket of rack-rinse water that is currently tipped into the yard drain

cons.claim: Enumerating every minor stream can bury the two or three that carry nearly all the hazard and value
cons.example: a fifteen-row list where the spent cyanide build bath and the still rinse deserve most of the attention

failure_modes: treating only the drums as waste and leaving rinse water, sludge and wipes off the list
omitting occasional streams — stripping solution, spill residue, a one-off customer rework — so they have no defined route when they appear
listing streams without their parent chemistry, which makes characterization guesswork later
acceptance_tests: every wet-line tank and every consumable on the line traces to at least one named output stream on the list
each stream row carries parent chemistry, physical form, gold-bearing flag and an arrival-rate estimate
revisit_triggers: a tank, chemistry or pretreatment step is added or removed
a new job type (rework, stripping, a different substrate) is accepted
an unlisted container appears anywhere in the shop

nodes.definition: Turn the hard chemical line into physical architecture that a tired person cannot cross by accident. Cyanide-bearing solutions, rinses and residues and acid-bearing solutions, rinses and residues are never mixed, never stored together and never share a drain — the in-repo cyanide-gold process notes record that contact of any cyanide solution, salt or rinse with any acid liberates hydrogen cyanide, including by accidental drain mixing, and that the same discipline binds the cyanide-free route for a different reason, because sulfite and thiosulfate chemistry releases sulfur dioxide on contact with acid. The map therefore fixes: distinct, visually unmistakable collection vessels per chemistry class; separate bunded storage areas with no shared secondary containment; separate transfer equipment, funnels and pumps that never cross classes; separate spill kits; and a drawn drain path showing where every floor and sink drain goes, with plating-area drains either sealed or leading to a dedicated collection point rather than a sewer. The gold line and the nickel/acid pretreatment line stay apart as well, for value as much as for hazard.

included: class-by-class collection vessel and storage-area assignment
dedicated transfer equipment and spill kits per class
a drawn drain map with destinations identified or sealed
the gold versus nickel/acid line separation
excluded: in-use chemical storage of purchased product, which is the chemical-safety sibling KB
spill response drills and signage readiness, also that sibling KB
the treatment or destruction of any stream, which is a licensed operation off site

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: layout, drainage or chemistry classes change, or a cross-contamination near-miss occurs

pros.claim: Physical separation makes the catastrophic mixing error require deliberate effort rather than a moment of inattention
pros.example: the cyanide collection carboy lives in its own bund on the opposite wall with its own funnel, so the pickle drum cannot be topped up into it in passing

pros.claim: Segregated collection preserves both the regulated class and the metal value of each stream
pros.example: keeping still-rinse gold concentrate out of the nickel rinse drum keeps it a reclaim asset instead of a mixed metal-bearing waste

cons.claim: Full segregation costs floor space, duplicate equipment and duplicate collections that a small shop feels acutely
cons.example: four bunded areas and four collection contracts in a bench shop with one wall of usable space

cons.claim: Segregation discipline decays under time pressure unless the layout enforces it
cons.example: a single unlabeled bucket used for 'whatever needs emptying' during a rush week that later cannot be characterized at all

failure_modes: one general-purpose waste container that quietly receives more than one chemistry class
shared funnels, hoses, pumps or drip trays that carry acid residue into a cyanide vessel
a floor drain in the plating area whose destination nobody has ever confirmed
storing cyanide-bearing and acid-bearing containers in the same bund because they are both 'waste'
acceptance_tests: cyanide-bearing and acid-bearing waste have physically separate containers, separate secondary containment, separate transfer equipment and separate spill kits, and this is verifiable by walking the shop
a drain map exists showing every drain in the wet area with its confirmed destination, and any drain not confirmed is sealed or bunded out of use
each collection vessel is unambiguously identified with its permitted chemistry class before it is first used
revisit_triggers: the shop layout, tank positions or storage areas change
a new chemistry class enters the line
any near-miss, cross-contamination or unexplained reaction in a waste container
a landlord, plumber or building change alters drainage

nodes.definition: Decide, and be able to defend, what each stream on the inventory actually is before it moves anywhere. The primary method is knowledge of inputs: the safety data sheets of every purchased product that went into the tank, the technical data sheet describing what the bath contains and what accumulates in service, and the process log of what was added, dragged in and dissolved. That yields the hazard properties — acutely toxic cyanide content, corrosivity, aquatic toxicity, heavy-metal content, and any doped grain refiner such as the arsenic or thallium compounds the in-repo process notes flag as turning an otherwise mild sulfite waste into unambiguous hazardous waste. Where inputs are not fully known, where streams were combined, or where the authority or the receiving facility requires it, the answer comes from accredited laboratory analysis, not from inference. The output is a written characterization sheet per stream, with its evidence attached and a review date, and the honest rule is that an uncharacterized container is a container nobody may lawfully accept.

included: input-knowledge characterization from safety and technical data sheets plus the process log
identifying when laboratory analysis is required instead
hazard-property determination and the doped-additive question
a written, evidenced, dated characterization sheet per stream
excluded: assigning a specific local waste code number as a fact, which comes from the naming authority
bath analysis for process control, which is bath-chemistry work
deciding the disposal route itself, which follows from the class

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a laboratory result, a supplier data-sheet revision, or a handler's incoming analysis contradicts the sheet

pros.claim: Characterizing from known inputs is cheap, fast and defensible when the shop only ever buys commercial products with data sheets
pros.example: a spent sulfite gold bath characterized from the product data sheet plus a log showing no doped brightener was ever added

pros.claim: A written characterization sheet travels with the stream and survives staff turnover
pros.example: a new bench hand can see from the sheet that the strike drum is cyanide-bearing and alkaline before touching it

cons.claim: Input knowledge fails exactly where it matters most — after a mixing mistake or with an inherited container
cons.example: a legacy carboy found during a shop move with a faded label and no process log, which now needs laboratory analysis before anyone will take it

cons.claim: Laboratory analysis costs real money per sample and can exceed the disposal cost of a small volume
cons.example: a five-litre unknown that costs more to analyse than a full scheduled collection of characterized drums

failure_modes: guessing the class from the tank's name rather than its actual contents and history
ignoring what accumulated in service — dragged-in metals, carbonate, dissolved substrate — and characterizing the make-up formula instead
missing a doped additive that reclassifies an otherwise mild stream
characterizing once and never revisiting after the process changed
acceptance_tests: every stream on the inventory has a dated characterization sheet naming its hazard properties and the evidence used
each sheet cites specific safety or technical data sheets and process-log entries, or an accredited laboratory report
any stream whose inputs are not fully known is flagged for analysis and is not moved until the analysis exists
revisit_triggers: a product, additive or supplier changes
two streams are accidentally combined
a receiving facility queries or rejects a described load
the process log shows an unusual drag-in or dissolution event

nodes.definition: Hold each characterized stream safely and legibly in the window between generation and collection. The work unit covers container material compatibility with the specific chemistry (alkaline cyanide solutions, strong acids and hot alkaline cleaners each attack different container and closure materials), keeping containers closed except when adding, never filling to the brim so thermal expansion and gassing have headroom, marking every container with its contents, hazard class, generating process and the date accumulation started, standing it in secondary containment sized for the largest vessel, and inspecting on a written cadence for corrosion, weeping, bulging, missing labels and lost caps. How long a container may stand and what the label must literally say are jurisdiction classes, so the register from the rule map supplies the local answer and the shop's own rule is always the tighter of the two.

included: container and closure material compatibility per chemistry class
closed-container, headspace and fill discipline
content, hazard, process and start-date marking
secondary containment and a written inspection cadence
excluded: storage of in-use purchased chemicals, which is the chemical-safety sibling KB
the numeric hold time and the exact statutory label wording, which are jurisdiction classes to confirm
transport packaging approval, which the licensed handler specifies

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a container failure, a labeling or hold-time rule confirmation, or a handler's packaging requirement

pros.claim: Marking contents and start date at the first drop keeps a container characterizable for its whole life
pros.example: a drum labeled 'spent alkaline cyanide gold build bath, gold-bearing, started 3 March' is still shippable a season later

pros.claim: Secondary containment turns a container failure into a cleanup instead of a drain incident
pros.example: a weeping carboy of spent pickle caught in its bund rather than running to a floor drain of unknown destination

cons.claim: Compatible containers, bunds and lids cost money and floor area up front, before any compliance benefit is visible
cons.example: buying purpose-made bunded pallets for three chemistry classes in a shop with one spare corner

cons.claim: Accumulation limits force collections that are uneconomically small for a low-volume bench
cons.example: a hold-time limit forcing a pickup of a part-full drum long before a full load has accumulated

failure_modes: reusing a food, solvent or beverage container, or a drum whose previous contents are unknown
leaving containers open 'because we are still filling them', letting fumes out and contamination in
labels written in marker that the parent chemistry itself dissolves or that fades to illegibility
no inspection cadence, so corrosion and weeping are discovered by smell or by a puddle
acceptance_tests: every waste container carries contents, hazard class, generating process and accumulation start date in durable marking
every container is closed, within its fill limit, standing in secondary containment appropriate to its class
a dated inspection log exists showing the cadence has actually been walked
revisit_triggers: a container shows corrosion, weeping, bulging or a lost label
a hold time or the confirmed local labeling requirement changes
collection is delayed and containers approach capacity

nodes.definition: Attack the volume of process solution that rides out of every tank on parts, racks and barrels, because that film is simultaneously the largest routine gold loss, the contamination path into the next tank, and the origin of most rinse-water waste volume — the in-repo cost notes for the cyanide gold route record that at small scale drag-out losses often exceed the gold actually deposited unless a still rinse returns solution to the bath. The levers are mechanical and geometric rather than chemical: withdraw slowly and hold the work over the tank so the film drains back instead of dripping on the floor; orient parts and design racks so nothing forms a cup, a blind pocket or a horizontal shelf; avoid barrel loads that trap solution in the perforations; keep tank level and rack loading consistent so drag-out per rack is predictable; and treat any surface-tension-reducing additive as a supplier-specified option whose effect on the deposit must be checked against the product data sheet, never a shop improvisation. Every litre not dragged out is a litre that never becomes rinse water, never needs a manifest, and never needs to be bought back as gold.

included: withdrawal rate and over-tank drain dwell
part orientation and rack geometry as drag-out levers
barrel and bulk-load carry-out
consistency of tank level and load so drag-out is measurable
excluded: rack design for current distribution and deposit uniformity, which is process-execution work
bath chemistry adjustments and additive dosing for plating performance
the rinse tanks themselves, which are the next work unit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: measured still-rinse fill rate or a reclaim settlement shows drag-out losses moving

pros.claim: Drag-out reduction pays twice — less gold leaves the tank and less waste volume leaves the shop
pros.example: adding a ten-second over-tank drain dwell to every rack, which visibly cuts both the still-rinse fill rate and the gold going to reclaim

pros.claim: The levers are free or nearly free, which suits a bench shop with no capital budget
pros.example: re-hanging a ring so its bezel cavity drains instead of holding a bead of bath solution

cons.claim: Longer drain dwell slows the line and, on some chemistries, risks the surface drying or passivating between steps
cons.example: holding nickel-plated work too long in air before the gold strike, when the process corpus requires transfer wet and live because nickel repassivates within minutes

cons.claim: Drag-out is invisible without deliberate measurement, so improvements are easy to claim and hard to prove
cons.example: a shop convinced its new rack is better with nothing but impression to support it

failure_modes: fast withdrawal straight from bath to rinse, with the film dripping across the floor between tanks
part geometry that cups solution being racked the way it was easiest to hang
extending drain time so far that the surface dries or passivates and the plate fails, so the batch is re-run and all the savings are lost
adding a wetting agent not sanctioned by the product data sheet and destabilising the bath
acceptance_tests: a written withdrawal-and-dwell practice exists per tank and is visible at the line
racking orientation for repeat part families is documented so the drainable position is repeated rather than rediscovered
still-rinse fill rate or rack-count-per-litre is tracked so a claimed drag-out improvement can be checked against an actual number
revisit_triggers: a new part geometry or rack design enters production
the metal-accounting reconciliation shows unaccounted gold rising
throughput pressure changes the withdrawal practice at the line

nodes.definition: Place an unflowing still rinse immediately after each expensive or hazardous tank so the drag-out film is captured in a small, concentrated, same-chemistry volume instead of being diluted into hundreds of litres of flowing rinse water. Parts dip there first; the concentrate strengthens over time and is used as evaporation make-up back into the parent bath where the chemistry and the bath's own contamination tolerance allow it, which is why the still rinse is described in the in-repo cost notes as the mechanism that stops drag-out losses from exceeding deposited gold. The judgement in this unit is when return is legitimate and when it is not: a still rinse belongs to exactly one bath and never serves two, return is only into the bath it came from, and the moment the bath's contamination indicators say drag-in is accumulating, the still rinse stops being make-up and becomes a gold-bearing stream for reclaim. For the sacrificial cyanide gold strike, whose whole design purpose is to absorb drag-in, that decision arrives sooner than for the build bath.

included: one still rinse dedicated per process tank
concentrate return as evaporation make-up and the conditions under which it is allowed
the switch from return to reclaim routing when contamination accumulates
still-rinse volume as a gold-bearing asset
excluded: deciding whether a bath is contaminated, which is bath-chemistry diagnostic work
flowing rinse design and water consumption, which is the next work unit
refining the recovered concentrate, which only a licensed reclaimer does

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: bath contamination trends or reclaim settlements show the return rule is set wrong

pros.claim: A still rinse converts the largest gold loss into recoverable inventory at almost no capital cost
pros.example: one extra tank of the same size after the gold bath, holding concentrate that goes back as make-up instead of down the rinse line

pros.claim: It shrinks the contaminated volume that has to leave under paperwork, which cuts collection cost as well
pros.example: a full carboy of concentrate to reclaim instead of a tank of dilute rinse water needing a licensed liquid-waste collection

cons.claim: Returning concentrate returns everything the parts dragged in with it, so it trades gold savings against bath life
cons.example: returning strike rinse into a build bath and importing dragged-in nickel and copper that stain the deposit

cons.claim: A still rinse only works if it is disciplined — one tank, one bath, no sharing — which is exactly what a crowded bench erodes
cons.example: the same still rinse quietly used after both the nickel and the gold tank during a busy week, ruining both routes

failure_modes: one still rinse serving two different chemistries, producing a mixed stream that is neither returnable nor cleanly reclaimable
returning concentrate into a bath that is already at its contamination limit, converting a gold saving into a bath dump
letting the still rinse become so dilute that it is neither useful make-up nor an economic reclaim lot

deposit staining or adhesion faults appear after a return event

nodes.definition: Design the flowing rinses so the work leaves clean while the shop generates the smallest possible volume of contaminated water, and so no two chemistry classes ever meet in a rinse line. The mechanisms are counterflow cascades, where fresh water enters the last tank and overflows backwards so the dirtiest water leaves nearest the process bath; rinse-on-demand rather than a hose running all shift; conductivity or simple dip-count criteria that say when a rinse is spent rather than guessing; and strict line separation so cyanide-bearing rinses, acid rinses and nickel rinses each have their own tanks and their own collection route. The compliance point sits underneath all of it: rinse water from a plating line is a regulated stream until an authority says otherwise in writing, so the architecture must assume every litre is going into a container, and the design goal is fewer litres rather than an easier way to get rid of them.

included: counterflow and cascade rinse sequencing
rinse-water changeover criteria and rinse-on-demand practice
per-chemistry-class rinse line separation and collection
designing for containerised rinse water as the default
excluded: the cleanliness specification the finish requires, which is process and quality territory
whether any water may be discharged, which is the discharge-permit work unit
treating rinse water on site to make it dischargeable

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a discharge decision from the authority, or measured rinse-water volume and quality data

pros.claim: Counterflow reaches the same rinse cleanliness on a fraction of the water, cutting both purchase and disposal volume
pros.example: two cascaded rinses after the gold tank replacing a single running rinse and roughly collapsing the weekly contaminated-water volume

pros.claim: Separate rinse lines per class keep the segregation rule intact where it is easiest to break
pros.example: the pickle rinse having its own tank and its own drum, so acid rinse water can never reach the cyanide rinse collection

cons.claim: Water reduction has a hard floor: cut too far and drag-in carries into the next tank and onto the part
cons.example: a starved rinse after the pickle carrying acid film into an alkaline cleaner and staining the work, forcing a strip and re-run

cons.claim: More rinse tanks means more floor space, more tanks to maintain and more streams to characterize
cons.example: three chemistry classes each needing their own two-stage cascade in a bench-sized wet area

failure_modes: one shared rinse tank serving tanks from different chemistry classes
a hose left running to a drain as the rinse strategy
changing rinse water by impression rather than by a stated criterion, so it is either wasteful or ineffective

a stated rinse-changeover criterion exists per line rather than an impression-based practice

revisit_triggers: a discharge permission is granted, refused or changed by the authority

nodes.definition: Handle the tank once someone else has decided the bath is finished. The retirement sequence is fixed and value-ordered: recover the metal first, then let what remains enter the regulated-waste route. In practice that means the gold-bearing solution goes to the reclaimer as solution or as a supplier refining credit rather than being poured into a mixed drum; the tank bottom is scraped and the sludge collected separately as gold-bearing solids; filters and anode bags come out and go with the solids; and the emptied tank's rinse-down water is captured, not flushed. The value at stake is not marginal — the in-repo cost notes describe a working gold bath as a metal inventory in solution, so a dumped bath is an asset being handed over, and a dumped cyanide strike is both an asset and an acutely toxic load. What this unit never does is decide whether the bath could have been corrected; that judgement belongs to the bath-chemistry specialist, and this unit begins the moment the answer is no.

included: metal-first, waste-second dump sequencing
tank sludge, filter and anode-bag collection at dump time
capturing tank rinse-down water
re-characterizing the retired bath as it actually is at end of life
excluded: diagnosing why the bath failed or whether it could be corrected, which is bath-chemistry work
on-site treatment or destruction of the drained solution
the reclaimer settlement terms, which are their own work unit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a retirement event exposes a missing container, route or characterization

pros.claim: Sequencing metal recovery before waste routing recovers value that would otherwise be paid to dispose of
pros.example: sending a retired build bath to the reclaimer as a gold-bearing solution lot rather than paying by the litre to have gold hauled away

pros.claim: Treating the dump as a defined event catches the streams that only exist at dump time
pros.example: the tank-bottom sludge and the anode bags, which have no route at all unless the dump procedure names them

cons.claim: A dump is a high-exposure day: large volumes of hot, concentrated, hazardous solution being moved by hand
cons.example: decanting a strongly alkaline cyanide bath into carboys, which the safety corpus treats as a splash and inhalation hazard needing formal training and controls

cons.claim: Retirement timing is not this unit's call, so the waste side is often told late and has to improvise capacity
cons.example: learning on the day that a full bath needs containers the shop does not have

failure_modes: pouring a retired bath into whatever drum has room, destroying both its class and its reclaim value
leaving sludge, filters and anode bags in the empty tank so they are later handled as workshop rubbish
flushing the emptied tank with water to the drain because 'it is only a rinse now'
carrying the make-up characterization forward instead of re-characterizing the bath as it ended up
acceptance_tests: a written dump sequence exists that recovers gold-bearing solution and solids before any waste routing step
container capacity and a booked collection or reclaim shipment are confirmed before the tank is opened
the retired bath and its sludge each get a fresh characterization sheet dated at retirement
revisit_triggers: a bath is retired for an unusual reason such as contamination or a crash
the reclaimer changes what solution forms it will accept
a dump generates a stream that was not on the inventory

nodes.definition: Decide, stream by stream, which outputs carry recoverable gold and route them to reclaim rather than into the disposal route where the metal is lost and the shop pays for the privilege. On a gold line the gold-bearing set is wider than most benches assume: retired strike and build baths, still-rinse concentrate, the first flowing rinse after the gold tank, spent filter cartridges and filter aid, tank-bottom sludge, anode bags, polishing and bench sweeps that touched plated work, wipes used on gold-wet surfaces, and the residue from stripping rework off customer pieces. The cyanide-free notes in the in-repo corpus make the same point from the other direction, calling gold-bearing spent bath and drag-out an asset rather than merely waste. Routing means each such stream has its own container, its own characterization and a reclaim destination, and that no gold-bearing stream is ever commingled with the nickel or acid streams, because commingling converts a metal credit into a mixed metal-bearing waste that costs money to move.

included: identifying the full gold-bearing set including solids and consumables
dedicated containers and characterization per reclaim stream
the no-commingling rule with nickel and acid streams
hand-over preparation such as draining, drying and consolidating like with like
excluded: refining, incineration or metal separation, all of which are licensed reclaimer operations
settlement terms and assay disputes, which are their own work unit
the finished part's gold content and its marking claims

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: reclaimer acceptance criteria change, or settlement results reveal a mis-routed stream

pros.claim: Routing turns the largest disposal cost centre into a metal credit
pros.example: a filter cartridge from the gold line going into the reclaim drum instead of a hazardous-waste drum the shop pays by weight to remove

pros.claim: Segregated reclaim streams assay higher and settle faster than mixed material
pros.example: keeping gold sweeps out of the nickel-contaminated sludge so the lot needs less refining work

cons.claim: Every additional reclaim stream is another container, another characterization and another storage decision
cons.example: separate small containers for wipes, filters and sweeps in a shop already short of bunded space

cons.claim: Reclaim value tempts a shop to hoard hazardous material past sensible limits to build an economic lot
cons.example: holding cyanide-bearing gold sludge for months to justify a shipment, against the container and hold-time discipline

failure_modes: binning gold-bearing solids because they look like consumables rather than metal
commingling gold-bearing and nickel-bearing streams and losing both the credit and the clean class
letting reclaim containers sit unlabeled because 'the refiner will sort it out'
shipping wet, dripping filter material that the reclaimer will not accept as delivered
acceptance_tests: the inventory marks every stream as gold-bearing or not, with the reason recorded
each gold-bearing stream has a dedicated, labeled container and a named reclaim destination
no reclaim container may lawfully receive nickel-line or acid-line material, and the labeling says so
revisit_triggers: the reclaimer changes accepted material forms or minimum lot sizes
a settlement assay comes back far from the shop's expectation
a new consumable (filter type, wipe, anode bag) enters the gold line

nodes.definition: Handle the solid and semi-solid fraction of the line as the regulated, metal-concentrating material it is: spent filter cartridges and filter aid from continuous bath filtration, tank-bottom sludge, the precipitate a crashed bath leaves on walls and heaters, spent activated carbon from bath purification, bench and floor sweeps, contaminated absorbent from spill cleanup, and exhausted extraction or scrubber media. Every one of these is wet with its parent chemistry, so it inherits that chemistry's hazard class — a cartridge from a cyanide gold bath is a cyanide-bearing waste, not a used filter — and most of them concentrate metals well above the solution they came from. The handling mechanisms are: drain over the parent tank before removal so the liquid stays in its own class, contain in a closed compatible container rather than a bag, keep gold-bearing solids apart from nickel-bearing solids, never dry or bake anything to reduce volume, and characterize the solid separately from the liquid it came from.

included: filter cartridges, filter aid, carbon, sludge, sweeps and contaminated absorbent
drain-over-tank practice at removal
closed compatible containment and separate characterization for solids
keeping gold-bearing and nickel-bearing solids apart
excluded: choosing filtration equipment or media for bath performance, which is bath-chemistry work
on-site drying, baking or ashing to reduce volume or upgrade metal content
the reclaimer's own processing of the delivered solids

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an analysis of a sludge or filter lot, or a receiver's rejection of a solids load

pros.claim: Treating solids as their own characterized stream closes the commonest quiet compliance gap in a small shop
pros.example: a cyanide-wet filter cartridge going into a labeled closed container instead of the workshop bin

pros.claim: Concentrated metal in solids often makes them the most valuable reclaim material per kilogram
pros.example: tank-bottom sludge from a gold bath assaying far richer than the same mass of the solution

cons.claim: Wet solids are awkward: they drip, they smell, and receivers refuse loads that arrive free-draining
cons.example: a reclaimer rejecting a drum of soaking filter cartridges that was not drained over the tank first

cons.claim: Solids are easy to under-characterize because their composition is genuinely uncertain
cons.example: sludge from a bath that had years of drag-in, where the metal mix is unknown without analysis

failure_modes: bagging used cartridges as general workshop rubbish because they look like consumables
removing a filter without draining it over its own tank, so the parent solution ends up on the floor and in the cleanup waste
mixing gold-bearing and nickel-bearing sludge in one drum for convenience
attempting to dry or heat residues on site to reduce volume or concentrate metal
acceptance_tests: every solid residue type on the line has a named container and a characterization sheet distinct from its parent liquid
a written removal practice requires draining over the parent tank before a filter or sludge leaves it
no solid residue route ends in a general waste bin or a bag
revisit_triggers: filtration media, filter aid or carbon type changes
a bath crash or precipitation event generates unusual solids
a receiver queries the moisture content or description of a solids load

nodes.definition: Treat every cyanide-bearing output — spent strike, spent build bath, all cyanide rinses, still-rinse concentrate, cyanide-wet filters and sludge, and cleanup residues — as its own top-severity class with three absolute rules and one routing decision. The rules: never acidify anything in this class, because the in-repo cyanide-gold process notes record that contact with any acid liberates hydrogen cyanide and that evolution begins as the solution's alkalinity falls, so the stream is held strongly alkaline for its whole life; never let it meet an acid stream in a container, a bund, a spill or a drain; and never discharge it, since the same corpus records cyanide as acutely toxic to aquatic life and untreated draining as unlawful. The routing decision for a jewelry bench is almost always ship-out: recover the gold first, then hand the residue to a licensed hazardous-waste destination under paperwork. The corpus names alkaline chlorination as the standard engineered destruction route with a verification step afterwards, and that is exactly why a licensed facility exists — it is a description of what a permitted operator does, never a bench procedure, and any on-site treatment ambition is a licensing, engineering and monitoring question to put to the authority before it is a chemistry question.

included: the never-acidify, never-co-store, never-discharge obligations for the whole cyanide-bearing set
holding the stream alkaline through its accumulation life
gold recovery before residue routing
ship-out to a licensed destination as the bench-scale route, and treatment named only as a licensed operation
excluded: any procedure for destroying cyanide on site
cyanide antidote, monitoring, exposure response and operator training, which belong to the chemical-safety sibling KB
the bath's operating chemistry and pH control in service, which is bath-chemistry work

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in the cyanide chemistry used, the licensed destination, or the jurisdiction's cyanide-waste rules

pros.claim: One absolute class rule removes judgement from the situation where judgement fails worst
pros.example: the standing instruction that nothing acidic ever goes near the cyanide waste carboy, with no exception for 'just neutralising it a bit'

pros.claim: Ship-out under paperwork gives the shop a defensible, auditable route without pretending to be a treatment facility
pros.example: a signed consignment copy showing a licensed destination received the spent strike, rather than an undocumented on-site process

cons.claim: Licensed cyanide-waste collection is expensive and infrequent, which strains both cash flow and storage discipline
cons.example: a minimum collection charge that dwarfs the value of the small volume a bench shop actually produces

cons.claim: The class swallows adjacent materials, so volumes grow faster than the bath alone would suggest
cons.example: cyanide-wet gloves, wipes and absorbent all inheriting the class and needing the same route

failure_modes: any attempt to neutralise, acidify or pH-adjust downward to 'make it safer' before disposal
storing cyanide-bearing waste in the same bund or on the same pallet as pickle acid
letting a cyanide rinse tank overflow to a floor drain
reading the alkaline-chlorination description as a set of instructions to try at the bench
acceptance_tests: every cyanide-bearing container is labeled with the never-acidify rule and stored in a bund that holds no acidic material of any kind
the shop can name its licensed destination and show a signed return copy for the most recent cyanide-bearing consignment

revisit_triggers: the licensed destination or hauler changes or its permit status changes
an acid container is found in or near the cyanide storage area
the shop considers changing to or from the cyanide gold route
any spill, overflow or near-miss involving a cyanide-bearing stream

nodes.definition: Give the pretreatment line its own handling class, because the nickel underplate and the acid pickle generate the second-largest hazard load in the shop and the corpus is explicit that nickel-line waste stays separate: nickel compounds carry carcinogen and skin-sensitiser classifications and are acutely toxic to aquatic life, so spent nickel baths, nickel rinses, nickel-bearing sludge and Wood's nickel strike solution are heavy-metal waste in their own right. Spent hydrochloric pickle and spent alkaline electrocleaner are corrosive streams whose only permissible relationship with the cyanide side is total separation — the same pickle rinse that is merely a nuisance in its own drum is the ingredient that turns a cyanide container into a gas generator. The work is to give this line its own containers, its own bund, its own transfer equipment and its own collection, to keep its metal content out of the gold reclaim route so the reclaim lot stays clean, and to resist the two shortcuts a small shop always reaches for: neutralising acid on site to 'make it drain-safe', and treating dilute nickel rinse as though dilution changed its class.

included: spent nickel baths, nickel rinses and nickel-bearing sludge as heavy-metal waste
spent pickle acid and spent alkaline electrocleaner as corrosive streams with mandatory separation from the cyanide side
dedicated containers, bund, transfer equipment and collection for the pretreatment line
keeping nickel out of the gold reclaim route
excluded: nickel-release limits for skin-contact finished goods, which belong to the marking and consumer-rules sibling KB
medical questions about nickel sensitisation, which route to professional care
pretreatment process chemistry and bath control, which is surface-prep and bath-chemistry work

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: pretreatment chemistry changes, or an authority or handler clarifies the heavy-metal stream requirements

pros.claim: A separate pretreatment waste class protects both the cyanide segregation line and the value of the gold reclaim lot
pros.example: spent pickle in its own bunded drum on the opposite side of the shop from any cyanide-bearing container

pros.claim: Nickel streams collected separately can be presented to a handler as a single well-described heavy-metal waste
pros.example: one clearly characterized nickel drum rather than a mixed metal-bearing liquid nobody wants to quote for

cons.claim: The pretreatment line generates the largest liquid volume for the least value, so it feels like pure cost
cons.example: far more litres of nickel and pickle rinse leaving the shop each month than gold-line liquid, with no metal credit against it

cons.claim: Acid and alkali streams invite the on-site neutralisation shortcut, which is a discharge decision disguised as chemistry
cons.example: adding alkali to spent pickle and calling the result drain-safe without any permit having been granted

failure_modes: neutralising spent acid on site and discharging it as though neutral meant clean, when the metals remain
assuming dilute nickel rinse is not really nickel waste
sharing pumps, funnels or drip trays between the pickle line and any cyanide-bearing vessel

revisit_triggers: the pretreatment chemistry or supplier changes

the handler's acceptance criteria for heavy-metal liquids change

nodes.definition: Set up the refining relationship before a lot ever ships, because everything that determines what the shop gets back is agreed in advance rather than discovered afterwards. The terms that matter are mechanical: what material forms the reclaimer accepts (solution, sludge, filters, sweeps) and in what condition; how a lot is weighed on arrival and whether the shop's weight or theirs governs; how the lot is dried, homogenized and sampled, and whether the shop may witness or retain a sample; how the assay is performed and what happens if the shop disputes it; the returns percentage and the refining, treatment and lot charges that come off the settled content; the minimum economic lot size; the settlement timing and form; and the chain-of-custody documentation, since precious-metal shipments often sit under both waste and valuables rules at once. The reclaimer's permit status is verified the same way a hauler's is. None of the commercial numbers are universal — they are negotiated per contract and per market, and the only honest way to state them is to read them off the agreement in front of you.

included: accepted material forms and delivery condition
weighing, drying, homogenizing, sampling and assay method plus the dispute path
returns percentage, refining and lot charges, minimum lot size and settlement timing as terms to read from the agreement
chain-of-custody documentation and permit verification
excluded: quoting any returns percentage, charge or settlement figure as a market norm
refining chemistry, which is the reclaimer's licensed operation
the shop's own bookkeeping treatment, which is the next work unit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a revised agreement, a disputed settlement, or a change in the shop's dominant material form

pros.claim: Agreeing sampling and assay method in advance converts the biggest source of settlement disputes into a known procedure
pros.example: a written term that the shop may retain a split sample of a sludge lot before it is refined

pros.claim: A named reclaimer with verified permits makes the gold route auditable rather than informal
pros.example: showing an inspector the reclaimer's permit reference alongside the consignment copies for gold-bearing solids

cons.claim: Minimum lot sizes and per-lot charges punish small benches, which pushes shops towards holding material too long
cons.example: a lot minimum that a one-person shop reaches only once a year, tempting storage past sensible limits

cons.claim: Terms are opaque and vary widely, so comparison shopping requires effort a busy bench rarely spends
cons.example: two quotes that look similar until the refining charge and returns basis are read side by side

failure_modes: shipping a lot before any terms are agreed and accepting whatever settlement arrives
assuming a returns percentage from a forum or a previous supplier applies to this contract
sending material in a form the reclaimer does not accept, so it is returned or downgraded
treating the reclaimer as outside the waste paperwork chain and skipping permit verification
acceptance_tests: a written agreement exists naming accepted forms, weighing, sampling, assay, dispute path, charges and settlement timing
the reclaimer's permit or licence status has been verified and the verification is dated
no returns or charge figure is quoted anywhere in the shop's own records except by direct reference to the agreement
revisit_triggers: the agreement or its charge schedule is revised

nodes.definition: Keep an honest account of where the shop's gold went, and be equally honest about which parts of that account are measured and which are estimated. The frame is a mass balance over a period: gold purchased as salt, concentrate or bath make-up, plus opening bath inventory, against gold deposited on work, gold still held in solution, gold settled by the reclaimer, and the remainder, which is loss. Deposited gold is computable rather than mysterious — it is plated area times thickness times the density of gold, which the in-repo cost notes reduce to roughly nineteen milligrams per square centimetre per micron for the arithmetic — but every input to that calculation is itself an estimate unless thickness is actually measured, so the result is labeled an estimate. The booking rule is strict: only the reclaimer's settled assay may be recorded as recovered metal or quoted to anyone as value; the shop's own estimate of a drum's content is a planning figure and is labeled as one, never presented to a customer, an insurer, a buyer or a tax record as though it were realised. The unaccounted remainder is not embarrassing, it is the measurement that drives drag-out work.

included: period mass balance across purchases, bath inventory, deposit, reclaim settlement and loss
the area-thickness-density arithmetic as a mechanism with its inputs labeled
the rule that only settled assay may be booked as recovered value
using the unaccounted remainder as the drag-out improvement signal
excluded: financial, tax or valuation advice, which is a qualified adviser's territory
quoting gold prices, wear-life or value guarantees
customer-facing claims about how much gold is on a piece, which is the marking and consumer-rules sibling KB

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: settlement statements, measured deposit thickness, or a reconciled period balance

pros.claim: A mass balance makes invisible losses visible and gives drag-out work a number to move
pros.example: a period where deposit plus settlement accounts for far less than purchases, pointing straight at rinse and drag-out practice

pros.claim: Booking only settled assay keeps the shop's records defensible to an accountant, an insurer or a buyer
pros.example: reclaim credited on the date the settlement statement arrives rather than when the drum was filled

cons.example: an unaccounted remainder that sits stubbornly across periods because bath inventory itself is only estimated

cons.claim: Honest estimating looks pessimistic next to a competitor quoting confident recovery figures
cons.example: declining to state a recovery percentage for a drum when a supplier's marketing does so freely

failure_modes: booking an estimated drum content as recovered value before any assay exists
treating the deposit arithmetic as measured fact when thickness was never measured
quietly writing off the unaccounted remainder instead of investigating it
presenting a planning estimate to a customer or insurer as a realised figure
acceptance_tests: every recorded recovery figure traces to a specific settlement statement
every estimated figure in the account is explicitly marked as an estimate with its method named
the period balance is reconciled and the unaccounted remainder is stated rather than absorbed
revisit_triggers: a settlement lands far from the shop's estimate

nodes.definition: Move regulated material off site only through a verified licensed chain, with the paperwork that proves it. The work unit has four parts: establish the shop's own standing as a generator, including whatever registration or notification the jurisdiction requires and which generator category the shop's quantities put it in; verify that the transporter and, separately, the destination facility hold current permits that actually cover the classes being moved, by checking the permit itself rather than accepting a business card; raise the consignment or manifest document that travels with the load, describing the waste as characterized, in the quantity and packaging actually presented, naming generator, carrier and destination; and close the loop by receiving and filing the signed copy that proves the load arrived where it was supposed to. The document names, thresholds and copy-retention rules differ by jurisdiction and come from the rule register, but the mechanism is universal: no verified licence, no transfer, and a load that leaves without paperwork has not been disposed of, it has been abandoned.

included: generator registration and category as a jurisdiction class to confirm
permit verification for both transporter and destination against the specific waste classes
raising an accurate consignment or manifest document per load
receiving and filing the signed return copy
excluded: naming the specific document, code or threshold used in any jurisdiction as universal
transport packaging and labeling approval, which the licensed carrier specifies
what the destination facility does with the material once it arrives

nodes.definition: Answer the question every plating shop eventually asks — may any of this water go down the drain? — with the only defensible default: nothing from the plating line goes to any drain unless a named authority has given the shop explicit written permission that covers that specific stream, and the in-repo process corpus leaves local discharge rules deliberately unresolved precisely because they are local. The reasoning frame is that discharge authority is a permit, not an inference: it names the discharge point, the streams allowed, any limits and monitoring, and the reporting the shop must do. Absent that document, every litre of rinse water, tank rinse-down, floor wash and spill cleanup water is a container-and-manifest stream. Two hard lines sit above any permit: cyanide-bearing and metal-bearing streams are never drained untreated, and dilution is never a treatment — adding water changes concentration, not class or total mass. The practical shop decision is therefore usually to design for zero discharge from the wet area and to treat any future permit as an improvement to pursue with the authority, not an assumption to build on.

included: zero-discharge default absent explicit written permission
what a discharge permission actually specifies (point, streams, limits, monitoring, reporting)
the never-drain rule for cyanide-bearing and metal-bearing streams
dilution rejected as a treatment concept
excluded: stating any numeric discharge limit, since the permit and the authority define it
designing or operating on-site effluent treatment, which is a licensed engineering exercise
domestic sanitary drainage unconnected to the wet area

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a written decision from the water or environmental authority, or a change in drainage or tenancy

pros.claim: A zero-discharge default is simple, always defensible, and removes the shop's most tempting shortcut

pros.claim: Framing discharge as a permit question turns a moral argument into an administrative one with a clear owner
pros.example: asking the water authority in writing rather than debating at the bench whether dilute rinse is 'basically water'
